summary: These tables report institution-level enrollment and instructional activity accumulated during July 1, 2014 through June 30, 2015, covering undergraduate and graduate activity in the IPEDS postsecondary institution reporting universe. The 12-month measure is intended to capture institutions with nontraditional calendars or short-term programs and summarizes activity across the full reporting year rather than at a single term.

The Completions files cover awards and related program offerings reported for July 1, 2014 through June 30, 2015 by postsecondary institutions in the survey universe. Records are institution-based, with the observation grain varying by table; awards include degrees and certificates, and the program-offering file derives offerings from completions during this period.

Fall Enrollment reports institution-level counts of students enrolled during the fall: as of October 15 or the institution’s official fall reporting date for traditional academic calendars, and at any time from August 1 through October 31 for program-based or continuous-enrollment calendars. The universe is eligible IPEDS postsecondary institutions and their enrolled students; tables may have multiple institution records when enrollment is split by student characteristics, while some tables contain one institution-level record. Counts describe enrollment populations rather than individual student records.

Finance data are collected during the winter collection period for the institution’s most recently completed fiscal year; fiscal year 2015 covers the reporting period designated by each institution for that fiscal year. The unit of observation is the postsecondary institution, with one finance report subject to the accounting-model form applicable to that institution. The survey covers Title IV-eligible institutions required to report finance information, with reporting organized by public GASB institutions, FASB institutions, and private for-profit institutions; finance collection is annual rather than limited to odd- or even-numbered years.

The Graduation Rates survey reports outcomes for full-time, first-time degree/certificate-seeking undergraduate cohorts, measured as of August 31, 2015. It covers eligible IPEDS institutions across four-year, two-year, less-than-four-year, and less-than-two-year sectors; records are institution- and cohort-based, with completion and transfer outcomes reported against normal-time thresholds.

The Human Resources survey describes staff at participating IPEDS postsecondary institutions, using fall payroll counts as of November 1, academic-year 2015-16 salary data, and new hires employed between July 1 and October 31, 2015. Records are institution-level staff counts or salary measures crossed with occupational, rank, employment-status, demographic, or tenure dimensions; eligibility varies by table, with the detailed degree-granting staff tables restricted to institutions with at least 15 full-time employees and related administrative offices. Some race/ethnicity and gender reporting is optional in even-numbered years, so coverage can be incomplete in those years.

These institution-level data are collected in the fall for the 2015-16 academic year, with institutions reporting their characteristics and applicable charges for that academic year. The universe is the 2015 IPEDS universe; reporting is mandatory for Title IV institutions, while non-Title-IV institutions may also appear where applicable. Most records are keyed to an institution’s IPEDS unitid, although some tables add survey-component, program, or comparison-group detail.

This survey covers institution-level reporting for the July 1, 2014–June 30, 2015 academic year by postsecondary institutions in the IPEDS/Title IV reporting universe. It contains aggregated counts, aid amounts, and related measures rather than student-level records; eligibility and populations vary by table and may be limited to undergraduates or particular aid recipients.
